source.note: Cryo Traveler (skillDepotId 505). Synthetic avatar_id 1000000505 = 1000000500 + depot suffix, matching the existing per-element traveler split; both twins share this row. Hit keys follow the existing traveler_*.json convention (normal 0-4, charged dmg1/dmg2, plunging dmg/low/high) rather than a GO sheet, since GO has not added this element yet. NOTE the constellation boosts are REVERSED from the other Travelers: C3 raises the BURST (Frostbound Javelin) and C5 the SKILL (Ice Fog Piercer). MODELLED 2026-08-09, having been listed here as gaps: (a) Frostglow's per-stack burst bonus, as the burstFrostglowStacks condition writing javelin_base_dmg_ (+5% of the javelin's base DMG per stack, 8 max) — scoped to the javelin by the javelin_dmg_ key in BASE_DMG_MULT_KEYS so it cannot leak onto Freezing Ice; (b) Charged Attack: Freezing Ice, as charged.freezingIce1/freezingIce2, each the ordinary CA multiplier PLUS freezingIceBonus_mult (1.4 x ATK) — the passive's +140% ATK applies to both CA hits — carrying only the Stellar keys, since under Radiance the attack IS a Stellar instance and the A1 +80% ATK explicitly does not apply to it (which is also why it must not carry charged_dmg_); (c) passive3 Stellar Jubilee, split self/others exactly like Odette's (see her file). A1's Cryo infusion IS baked in as of 2026-08-09 (NA, plain CA and plunge hit definitions are cryo/cryo_dmg_, not physical) — a deliberate departure from this repo's usual don't-bake-infusions rule, on the Xiao precedent: this Traveler's whole kit presumes Radiance, so a physical Normal is not a state that occurs. The a1EverKeenFrostInfusion condition therefore only carries the +80% ATK half. NOT MODELLED: there is no Cryo (non-Radiance) variant of Freezing Ice, which would need care to keep A1 off it. The Stellar SWIRL variants got their hit definitions when Stellar Swirl was implemented (2026-08-09): burst.javelinStellarSwirlDmg and charged.freezingIceSwirl1/2, the same instances under Radiance: Stellar Swirl instead of Stellar-Conduct. The swirl javelin carries javelin_dmg_ too, so burstFrostglowStacks feeds it identically — and correctly, since frostglowStellarSwirlDmgBonus_ is the same 5%-of-base per stack. Remember all three forms of an instance (Cryo / Conduct / Swirl) are mutually exclusive: never put more than one in a rotation. ADDITIONAL BUFF EFFECTS, added 2026-08-14: the quest-unlocked passive 'Foreign Permafrost' (nanoka passives[].unlock [603101]) opens with 'every Elemental Type the Traveler has resonated with now grants an additional enhancement effect' — the effects themselves are NOT in the passive text, they live in the in-game glossary (nanoka hyperlink.json entry 10050001) and in param[0..6], identical on all seven Travelers: Anemo +10% CRIT Rate, Geo +20% DEF, Electro +20% Energy Recharge, Dendro +60 Elemental Mastery, Hydro +20% HP, Pyro +20% ATK, Cryo +20% CRIT DMG. All seven are seeded unconditionally in self_modifiers_json, i.e. ASSUMING A FULLY-RESONATED ACCOUNT: Enka exposes neither the resonance list nor whether the passive is unlocked, so there is nothing to gate on. (fightPropMap does include passive stat bonuses — Kokomi's -100% CRIT Rate shows up there — but the evaluator rebuilds stats from sources via build_base_stats_from_sources and never reads fightPropMap, which is why every unconditional passive stat effect has to be seeded like this.) The rest of Foreign Permafrost (Icepoint stacks, Charged Attack: Freezing Ice) was already modelled above. QUEST BASE-STAT BONUSES, added 2026-08-14: base_stats_json above is deliberately NOT the raw game curve value. The Traveler carries three permanent quest rewards: +3 Base ATK from Activated Canned Knowledge (Archon Quest Ch. III Act I 'Ever So Close', step 5) and +7 Base ATK / +15 Elemental Mastery / +50 Base HP from Special Training in Skirk's Story Quest (Crystallina Ch. Act I, steps 2/6/9). So baseAtk 212.397192 -> 222.397192, baseHp 10874.914859 -> 10924.914859, and baseEleMas 15 (the only character in this seed set with a non-zero base EM). Verified against Enka: over all 338 level-90 builds in the local DB, the Traveler is the ONLY character whose fightPropMap base HP differs from its seed (by exactly +50.00), whose base-ATK residual exceeds weapon mainStatValue display rounding (+9.66), or whose EM carries an unexplained +15. These are flat and level-independent, so scale_base_stats_to_level will scale them by ~1.7% too much on a level-100 board (0.17 ATK / 0.85 HP) -- not worth a special case. DO NOT 'correct' these back to the nanoka/Amber curve values: the base-stat audit script will flag all seven travelers for exactly this.

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: A1 Ever-Keen Frost (Radiance: Stellar-Conduct, needs a Frostpierce Star on the field): the Traveler's Normal/Charged/Plunging Attacks are converted to Cryo DMG that cannot be overridden, and their DMG is increased by 80% of the Traveler's ATK. This toggle carries only the +80% ATK half — the Cryo conversion is baked into the NA/CA/plunge hit definitions (they are cryo, not physical), since this Traveler only ever fights inside Radiance, the same way Xiao's normals are seeded as anemo. So a rotation that scores a Normal, plain Charged or plunge target gets Cryo whether or not this condition is enabled; enable it for the ATK bonus.

Frostglow stacks consumed by Frostbound Javelin (max 8): each adds 5% of the javelin's base DMG, so 8 stacks is +40%. Applied as javelin_base_dmg_, a base-DMG multiplier scoped to the javelin via its javelin_dmg_ key — Freezing Ice is a Stellar instance too and must not collect it. Consuming 8 stacks also raises the javelin from 3 to 5 DMG instances, which is a rotation weight rather than a modifier.

Stellar Jubilee: Illusory Frostmirror — when a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and that reaction's BASE DMG rises by 0.35% per 100 of the TRAVELER's ATK, capped at +7% (2,000 ATK). Same shape and same scope split as Odette's version: this is the SELF half, offered only when the Traveler is the scored character, so the stellarglimmer_basedmg_from_atk_ / _cap_ conversion reads the build's own live post-buff ATK. The OTHERS half is passive3StellarJubileeSourceAtk.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: C2 Frostfall Reverberation: the active character gains +60 Elemental Mastery for 5s when an opponent is hit by an ice crystal from the Elemental Skill. If that character then triggers a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, the bonus is raised to 120 for the rest of its duration.

C6 Brumal Grimfrost: every Frostglow stack consumed by the Elemental Burst increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by OTHER party members by 5% for 15s, up to +40% (8 stacks). Uses stellarglimmer_dmg_, so it is scoped to both Stellar reactions; Stellar Swirl DMG itself is still unimplemented, so there are no Swirl hits for it to land on yet.

others_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Stellar Jubilee: Illusory Frostmirror, OTHERS half — offered only when the Traveler is a teammate. The converted reaction's BASE DMG rises by 0.35% per 100 of the TRAVELER's ATK (cap +7%), and the scored build's ATK belongs to the receiving character, so type the Traveler's ATK into the input. Clamped at 2,000, exactly where the cap lands; blank assumes the capped 2,000. The SELF half is passive3StellarJubileeOwnAtk — different scopes, so the two can never both apply.
